title: CVE card facts of CIRCL Vulnerability-Lookup (P181), OSV/GHSA (P185), VulnCheck KEV (P186), SecurityContext (P188) and the end-of-life rule (P187)
notes: Facts added to the consolidated CVE card with provenance (P183 cond 5). 'kev' stays CISA-only: CIRCL sightings and VulnCheck KEV hits go to the core attribute 'exploited' (sources 'circl' and 'vulncheck_kev'). SecurityContext values are comparison-only (cve_secondary), never the sole source of a card attribute.

attributes.circl_sightings: CIRCL Vulnerability-Lookup sightings summary {types: {seen|exploited|confirmed|published-proof-of-concept|...: {first, last, count, families}}, total, complete, exploited_types, kev_catalogues}: community observations (counts, dates and source families only), never CISA KEV
attributes.linked_advisories: list of advisory ids a source links to the vulnerability (vendor CSAF, distro, GHSA records): related records, not aliases
attributes.advisory_aliases: list of advisory ids naming the same vulnerability (CVE, GHSA, PYSEC, distro record ids): the de-duplication key across CVE sources
attributes.distro_fixes: list of per-release distro fixes {distro, release, codename, package, fixed, status, subscription, record} from OSV distro records (backported fixes: banner revisions are checked offline by P355)
attributes.package_ranges: list of compact affected package ranges {ecosystem, package, introduced, fixed, last_affected, limit, source} from OSV/GHSA records (never whole records)
attributes.withdrawn_advisories: list of withdrawn advisory ids found for the vulnerability (context only, never used as facts)
attributes.exploitation_refs: list of URLs reporting in-the-wild exploitation of a CVE (e.g. VulnCheck KEV reported exploitation): links only, never fetched
attributes.vulncheck_kev: VulnCheck KEV entry {date_added, cisa_date_added, ransomware_use, reported_exploitation, exploits}: company community key, not redistributed - exports carry only the CVE id and the exploited flag (P186)
attributes.cve_secondary: comparison-only CVE facts of a secondary source {provider, cvss, epss, cwe, kev_lists, exploitation_seen, public_exploits_total, patch_available, nvd_status, rejected_by_nvd, dataset_date}: never the sole source of a card attribute (P188)
attributes.nuclei_templates: list of nuclei template ids covering the CVE: informational only, never downloaded or run (P188 cond 5)

tags.end_of_life: a detected software release cycle is past its end-of-life (or end-of-active-support) date per endoflife.date

relations.advisory_alias: vulnerability id -> another advisory id naming the same vulnerability (CVE, GHSA, PYSEC, distro record ids)
relations.linked_advisory: vulnerability id -> advisory a source links to it (vendor CSAF, distro, GHSA record): related, not an alias
relations.public_exploit: CVE -> public exploit/PoC URL listed by a source (unverified: never fetched, downloaded or run)
